requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the rear lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the rear lamp ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the rear lamp ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), except where the lamp is intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp and the functions are not provided by multiple light sources, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.

requirements.text: The non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough

requirements.text: Any protuberances on the outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.quote: any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the lamp shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the RI verification of the retro-reflectors shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking on the rear lamp, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: For the resistance to corrosion test, the retro-reflector, or the rear lamp where the retro-reflector is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
atomic: For the resistance to corrosion test, the retro-reflector, or the rear lamp where the retro-reflector is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts.

For the resistance to corrosion test, the retro-reflector, or the rear lamp where the retro-reflector is combined with a light, shall be subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours.
For the resistance to corrosion test, the 50-hour saline mist exposure shall comprise two periods of exposure of 24 hours each.
For the resistance to corrosion test, the two 24-hour exposure periods shall be separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: When the retro-reflector is illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1., the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from the retro-reflector, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used. The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps of the rear lamp, the approval mark may be located anywhere on the lamps only if no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.quote: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
